home.slogan: Professional education platform for pharmaceutical specialists.
home.leadBody: Seminars, webinars, e-learning, testing, BPR points, certificates, materials, and a participant cabinet for healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical-device, and GMP/GDP specialists.
home.trustBody: Assessment, testing, certification, and BPR portfolio procedures are documented for legal review before production.
home.verifyBody: An employer or external reviewer sees only the minimum certificate data.

about.title: About the platform
about.body: The platform’s mission is to support professional development for pharmaceutical, medical-device, and quality-system specialists through educational events, testing, materials, and transparent certification.

bpr.title: BPR/CPD
bpr.body: This page explains the continuing professional development flow: educational events, testing, point accrual, certificates, and participant portfolios. Before production launch, the legal team must confirm that the wording meets current requirements.
